lines.text: Tola of Issachar judged Israel twenty-three years, and then Jair the Gileadite judged twenty-two years.
Israel again did evil and served the Baals and Ashtoreths, so the LORD sold them to the Philistines and Ammonites.
The Philistines and Ammonites oppressed Israel in Gilead for seven years, and the Ammonites crossed the Jordan to fight Judah, Benjamin and Ephraim.
Israel cried out to the LORD, but He said He would no longer save them, so they put away the foreign gods.
The Ammonites camped in Gilead and the Israelites camped at Mizpah, where the rulers promised leadership to whoever attacked first.
